runs/ingest-quotes.yaml:
run: ingest-quotes
title: Cluster a new quote into a theme and refresh counts
budget: {per_run: 0.10}
params:
  quote: {type: ref, to: feedback}
  themes: {type: refs, to: theme, default: "status:New"}
steps:
  - id: cluster
    title: Match the quote to a theme
    ai:
      prompt: |
        A new piece of product feedback arrived.
        Quote: {{params.quote.text}}
        Source: {{params.quote.source}} (author {{params.quote.author}})
        Existing themes to consider:
        {{params.themes}}
        Choose the theme whose name best matches this quote and reply with its exact id as theme_id.
        Also give that theme's mention count after this quote as mentions.
        If no theme fits, leave theme_id empty and give a short proposed theme name as new_theme.
      output:
        type: object
        required: [theme_id, mentions, new_theme]
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          theme_id: {type: string}
          mentions: {type: integer}
          new_theme: {type: string}
      example:
        theme_id: "00000000000000000000000011"
        mentions: 4
        new_theme: ""
  - id: assign
    title: Assign the quote to its theme
    if: $steps.cluster.output.theme_id != ""
    records.update:
      type: feedback
      id: $params.quote.id
      set:
        theme: $steps.cluster.output.theme_id
  - id: count
    title: Refresh the theme mention count
    if: $steps.cluster.output.theme_id != ""
    records.update:
      type: theme
      id: $steps.cluster.output.theme_id
      set:
        mentions: $steps.cluster.output.mentions
